[Highlight start] It is generally best to **avoid drinking alcohol while taking prednisone** [Highlight end] . While there is no direct chemical interaction listed between them, combining alcohol and prednisone increases overlapping side effects and can worsen the condition you are treating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16w4s9kbojqCD2_rH3SGU6d3ZNRXQ0y035yXHhM1-0uAcYB_ubJ1M1vC1AcXPLjX5dFxX07u_pSO_qKzQ6_jGEcewby_cP8u9oYCFXh6zHUEwulxu8-0lP3gKT_cewDGb-FSbyMRDWg2rXWvTPPkhr6Ytuz0B_uWk6zDihmj6d3DVg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX3r5quUirPxKOpS59sZyLpkfZbfSpmSriEo4FZ5wjPBX-308kwCosXJZ-fuEt7nq_QPUIQZohfiHpU1xK1l1Nrdew21owgzNO1ObO31knKwt8IaSjuw7Iexuk4gE3qZTva4TfSF2fyZsTztU)

### Key Risks of Mixing Prednisone and Alcohol

- **Stomach irritation and ulcers:** Both can irritate the stomach lining. Combining them raises the risk of gastritis, ulcers, and gastrointestinal bleeding—especially if you also take NSAIDs (like ibuprofen) or blood thinners.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXBXF_bn_VloH4jL51BZZHQN2jU20qtlUKF4JGl_d_ZjW25FyLDiuIrXjPlgCJz1DIShYTp5fawU0sfkbpdIh_zF8x5TsXPij9G6jzKSZwAbubQ63yP5s5H8a4tp8vFpkqrj7781EVK1MixM8K8RwcM3jg51tj2nOyxg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXSOzMgqJVvWMHUEQWGgwqCcdvpHr_LwCwmnP7hPmF4FzoHwRMV1v90METNIr_BGluV5t4mBTYXJt3YOg2HbwxwO85LSmiHxbrB9AC3xocT5Ky2_1Mr6vd78BadmyFWgyAn_x-986S7DgXfQ)
- **Weakened immune system:** Both prednisone and alcohol suppress immune defenses, making infections harder to fight or recover from.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX3r5quUirPxKOpS59sZyLpkfZbfSpmSriEo4FZ5wjPBX-308kwCosXJZ-fuEt7nq_QPUIQZohfiHpU1xK1l1Nrdew21owgzNO1ObO31knKwt8IaSjuw7Iexuk4gE3qZTva4TfSF2fyZsTztU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXBXF_bn_VloH4jL51BZZHQN2jU20qtlUKF4JGl_d_ZjW25FyLDiuIrXjPlgCJz1DIShYTp5fawU0sfkbpdIh_zF8x5TsXPij9G6jzKSZwAbubQ63yP5s5H8a4tp8vFpkqrj7781EVK1MixM8K8RwcM3jg51tj2nOyxg)
- **Blood sugar swings:** Prednisone can raise blood sugar, while alcohol can cause unpredictable fluctuations.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXSOzMgqJVvWMHUEQWGgwqCcdvpHr_LwCwmnP7hPmF4FzoHwRMV1v90METNIr_BGluV5t4mBTYXJt3YOg2HbwxwO85LSmiHxbrB9AC3xocT5Ky2_1Mr6vd78BadmyFWgyAn_x-986S7DgXfQ)
- **Mood and sleep changes:** Both can contribute to mood swings, anxiety, irritability, and disrupted sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF16dT0WNr5OPJWoXf_DY4Ej864tSkDrPCS6QCUHeyaVa_NrO_xBntr3nJXdOrQY22_C5zTQowyypl5XekRw_jz1TCj0bkYmHwYKxw3wvF8km-b_rRta8m8u46KIyo4yTEvtihoE0nmXG9s3oG_85dVVX66ZjKE43r46j3wFjfcr0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXSOzMgqJVvWMHUEQWGgwqCcdvpHr_LwCwmnP7hPmF4FzoHwRMV1v90METNIr_BGluV5t4mBTYXJt3YOg2HbwxwO85LSmiHxbrB9AC3xocT5Ky2_1Mr6vd78BadmyFWgyAn_x-986S7DgXfQ)
- **Long-term strain:** Higher doses or longer courses increase risks such as bone thinning (osteoporosis), high blood pressure, and liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF14SXQchnf6FfJNIILgzHZRwk6GEVc6Pv5JBPkxRcm9uGAC8hHieEUw9klAXPhgV8aEZmMF08kwonqk8EJha_f8EeuIZdx395JmLn3jeFJm4iT1yjKuh8L5U6_jkQe2rDPLf5zz9Gvh_7C1CXEenGCxGdAJnACOmlzBY6KFIJ6bfz98VPdsuZu23hVRCqk1LafVKMbVtNqnLEdcA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16w4s9kbojqCD2_rH3SGU6d3ZNRXQ0y035yXHhM1-0uAcYB_ubJ1M1vC1AcXPLjX5dFxX07u_pSO_qKzQ6_jGEcewby_cP8u9oYCFXh6zHUEwulxu8-0lP3gKT_cewDGb-FSbyMRDWg2rXWvTPPkhr6Ytuz0B_uWk6zDihmj6d3DVg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXSOzMgqJVvWMHUEQWGgwqCcdvpHr_LwCwmnP7hPmF4FzoHwRMV1v90METNIr_BGluV5t4mBTYXJt3YOg2HbwxwO85LSmiHxbrB9AC3xocT5Ky2_1Mr6vd78BadmyFWgyAn_x-986S7DgXfQ)

- **Check with your doctor or pharmacist:** Ask whether an occasional drink is safe for your specific dose, treatment length, and health history.
